title: SlimStash Zebrawood
description:
SlimStash Zebrawood
The SlimStash is a stripped down version of the dynastash, design to carry just a standard 92mm vapcap.
﻿Please Note that this slimstash is for a standard sized vapcap that is approximately 92mm in length.
Included
1 x SlimStash Zebrawood
